scope: Retail disposition of the SERVER_UTC launch argument and the launcher PE patch at RVA 0x009A15E3.
verdict: The values are timestamps from two independent client paths, not two checks or two encodings of one client mechanism. SERVER_UTC feeds only title-screen copyright-year formatting. The PE patch replaces a live _time64 call whose result is sent as a lobby client number and included in MD5-derived Blowfish key material.

values.disposition: Preserve as the launch argument value; document that the retail consumer is presentation-only copyright-year selection.
Rename as a fixed lobby client number or fixed lobby handshake time, not SERVER_UTC. The unpatched executable computes this field dynamically.

decoder.behavior: Validates the sqex wrapper, derives the tick-based Blowfish key, decodes the payload, and passes plaintext key/value tokens to FUN_00450340.

consumer.parse: FUN_0044FAF0 at VA 0x00403864 parses unsigned decimal to 64 bits
consumer.computation: CRT time conversion -> tm_year + 1900 -> comparisons with 2011 and 2010 -> title copyright text

negativeClaims: No lobby handshake or cryptographic use
No other direct reader of the stored 64-bit value

writer.behavior: When object+0x08 is zero, caches _time64(NULL) there; writes it to InitialSessionData+0x74.

downstream.behavior: Includes object+0x08 in the 0x2C-byte MD5 input at object+0x04; the 16-byte digest initializes Blowfish and decrypts the 0x280-byte secure-session body.

pePatchPath.comparison: No client comparison. The value is transmitted handshake and key-derivation input.
pePatchPath.staticStoppingPoint: The generic connection framework invokes the LobbyCryptEngine overrides through CryptEngineInterface virtual dispatch. The client binary contains no remote acceptance comparison.

firstConnection: packet 833 c2s payload+0x84 = 12 e8 e0 50; InitialSessionData+0x74
repeatConnection: packet 874 c2s payload+0x84 = 1b e8 e0 50; InitialSessionData+0x74
wireCorroboration.interpretation: The nine-second change between connections corroborates a live clock-derived client number. The patch value equals the first captured connection's number.

boundedAbsence.scope: All TCP payloads in the 54 immutable pcap-1.23b members plus canonical derived/catalog/study artifacts before the new study record.
boundedAbsence.result: No cleartext or binary occurrence of 1356916742. The account path in login.pcapng is TLS-wrapped, so absence cannot inspect its plaintext.
boundedAbsence.ceiling: INSUFFICIENT-DATA for server-side equality, clock-skew window, expiry, or rejection behavior.
